_about: Briefs for the painted card fronts (generated with Kling, kling-image-v3_0_omni, 2k, 3:4). Prompt = style.before + palette + scene + style.after. Outputs are cropped by tools/crop-art.py into public/cards/<suit>-<rank>.webp.

style.before: Illustrated tarot card artwork: one full-bleed scene that fills the entire canvas edge to edge, with no border, no frame, no margin, no text, no letters, no numbers. Detailed pen-and-ink engraving with dense crosshatching and fine stippling, finished with muted watercolour washes. Rich esoteric symbolism in the tradition of the Rider-Waite and Thoth tarot decks and old alchemical and emblem-book woodcuts.
style.after: Mysterious, contemplative and quietly unsettling, like a tarot card that speaks to the person who drew it; not horror: no monsters, no tentacles, no gore, no blood. One coherent scene with a single clear focal subject, and every symbol sitting naturally inside that scene: no floating emblems, inset medallions, banners, decorative bands, lettering or pentagrams. Iconic, centred vertical composition with the main subject in the middle and nothing important at the very top or bottom edges or in the top-left and bottom-right corners. Fine expressive linework, visible paper texture, museum-quality illustration.

palettes.clubs: Limited palette of slate grey, bone white, deep teal and tarnished ochre.
palettes.spades: Limited palette of cold indigo, pale silver-grey, dusk violet and bone white.
palettes.hearts: Limited palette of deep crimson, antique gold, warm sepia and bone white.
palettes.diamonds: Limited palette of ember orange, smoke grey, deep teal and bone white.

scenes.clubs-A: Theme: sleep, the way the body prepares for death. A young woman asleep on a carved stone bier beneath a crescent moon, hands folded over a sprig of poppies; a white owl perched at her head; an hourglass lying on its side at her feet; pale moths circling a guttering candle; twin winged youths, one holding a lowered torch and one a poppy, carved into the side of the bier; a curtain of stars drawn half closed behind her.
scenes.clubs-2: Theme: decay, the rot that lingers on the fingertips after touching the living. A single pale hand reaches into the picture to touch a blooming rose on a rosebush; everywhere its fingertips have brushed, petals and leaves wither, curl and fall away as grey dust, while the untouched blooms beyond stay full and vivid; a fallen apple softening in the grass with a butterfly resting on it; mushrooms rising from the soil at the roots.
scenes.clubs-3: Theme: execution, the final decree from a power that hears no appeals. A hooded executioner stands calmly on a wooden scaffold at dawn, leaning on a great two-handed sword; a scroll with a black wax seal is nailed to the post; a broken quill and a white lily lie on the planks; ravens line the gallows beam; a bell tower tolls in the distance under a pale rising sun.
scenes.clubs-4: Theme: tomb, the lightless residence where bloodlines turn to dust. The entrance of an ancient family mausoleum set into a hillside, its iron door slightly ajar onto darkness; a family tree carved over the lintel with the names worn smooth; funerary urns in niches; an oil lamp burning on the step; ivy and yew branches; a sleeping hound guarding the threshold; a key hanging from a black ribbon.
scenes.clubs-5: Theme: slaughter, the endless labour of harvesting souls to feed the earth. A gaunt reaper in a grey hooded cloak, face in shadow, mid-swing with a great scythe through an endless field of wheat at dusk, each ear of wheat glowing faintly like a tiny candle flame; the cut stalks fall onto a furrow of dark open earth that seems to drink them in; crows follow the blade; bound sheaves stand in rows behind him; a windmill on the far horizon.
scenes.clubs-6: Theme: martyrdom, the sacrifice that waters the roots of dogma. A serene robed figure bound to a dead tree, eyes calm and lifted, arrows lodged in the trunk all around; masked onlookers below holding candles; the tree's roots drinking from a golden chalice; white doves rising; a crown of thorns hanging from a branch; a book burning at the base of the tree.
scenes.clubs-7: Theme: murder, the buried truth beneath the floorboards of the mind. Night in a dim candlelit study: a figure kneels on the floor, lifting a loose floorboard to peer at a locked iron box hidden beneath; the candle throws their long shadow up the wall, and the shadow does not quite match their pose; a dagger lies beside the box; a raven watches from the windowsill; a stopped pocket watch lies on the floor; a cracked mirror on the wall reflects a single watching eye.
scenes.clubs-8: Theme: entropy, the unravelling of all order into stillness. A great woven tapestry of a cosmic geometric pattern unravelling, its threads pulling loose and pooling into dust; a crumbling clockwork orrery; a cracked nautilus shell; sand pouring from a fractured urn; an ouroboros serpent whose body fades into ash; stars dimming one by one in a darkening sky.
scenes.clubs-9: Theme: carrion, the feast where the fallen sustain the scavengers. A great stag lies on its side in a forest clearing, lifeless, its body limp and its head resting heavily on the moss with eyes closed, its antlers splayed across the ground; a ring of crows has gathered close around the body and a vulture has landed on its flank; small flowers and mushrooms push up through the fallen leaves where it lies; a fox waits at the edge of the clearing; bare autumn trees; a pale crescent moon. Death quietly feeding new life.
scenes.clubs-10: Theme: expiration, the final grain of sand slipping through an hourglass swallowed by the void. A giant hourglass at the centre with its last few grains falling, the upper bulb opening into a starless black void; a guttering candle stub; a calendar torn to its last page; withered flowers in a vase; a sundial in shadow; a pale hand reaching to turn the glass and stopping short.
scenes.clubs-J: Theme: loss of innocence, the first realisation that everything you love will one day end. The Page: a young boy in a simple tunic stands at the edge of a garden at dusk, holding a small still songbird in cupped hands; a broken wooden toy horse at his feet; a white rose shedding its petals; a butterfly pinned under a glass dome; a swing hanging motionless from an old oak; a bright garden behind him and a darkening path ahead.
scenes.clubs-Q: Theme: winter, the cold breath that puts the world into a frozen grave. The Queen of Winter, large and regal, fills the card: a pale crowned queen seated on a throne carved from ice in a snowbound forest, wearing a crown of icicles and holly; her breath is a frosty mist that turns the last falling leaves to frost; a white wolf sleeps curled at her feet; frozen birds sit on the bare branches beside her; at the foot of the throne the snow is cut away to show seeds sleeping in the dark soil; a dim white winter sun behind her head like a halo.
scenes.clubs-K: Theme: apocalypse, the total collapse of the grand cosmic design. The King of the End, large and regal, fills the card: a crowned king in tattered royal robes sits on a cracked throne at the top of a collapsing stone tower, calmly holding a fractured golden orb as the sky above him splits open; stars and burning fragments fall around him; an eclipsed black sun; far below on the plain four tiny horsemen ride; an architect's compass and plans slip from his lap and fall.
scenes.spades-A: Theme: illness, the isolation of flesh that has turned against you. A pale figure sitting alone in a narrow bed in a bare stone room, wrapped in blankets; a single shaft of moonlight from a high barred window; medicine bottles and a cup on a stool; a silent songbird in a cage; a wilted flower; the figure's shadow on the wall turned away from them; an empty chair by the door.
scenes.spades-2: Theme: phantom, the memory of warmth that only chills the bone. A woman alone in a cold moonlit room, eyes closed, hugging her own shoulders with her arms crossed, where a lover's arms should be; behind her the faint, translucent misty silhouette of a lover embracing her, already dissolving into the cold air; delicate frost ferns bloom across the windowpane; two teacups on the table, one untouched with its steam gone; a folded shawl left over the back of an empty chair; her breath visible in the cold. Her own two hands are the only hands in the picture: no handprints, no gloves, no other hands.
scenes.spades-3: Theme: tyranny, the isolation of ruling a kingdom of ash. A lone king on an enormous black iron throne set on a mound of ash and rubble, a heavy iron crown pressing on his brow; behind him a whole kingdom of burnt, roofless towers under falling grey ash; chains hang from the throne's arms; in front of him a long banquet table runs toward the viewer with every chair empty; a single crow perched on the table is his only courtier.
scenes.spades-4: Theme: asylum, the locked doors built to keep the frightening world away. A figure curled up in a pristine white padded room; a corridor of locked doors receding behind; a tiny high window showing a beautiful distant landscape; an unbuckled straitjacket on the floor; a key hanging just outside the bars; birds scratched into the walls; a single potted plant reaching toward the light.
scenes.spades-5: Theme: obsession, solitary toil in the dark that estranges mind from heart. A gaunt scholar hunched over a cluttered desk by the light of one candle in a dark tower room; towering stacks of papers; star charts and diagrams pinned to every wall; an untouched plate of food; a spider's web across the door; a stopped clock; through the window, a warmly lit house where a family dines together.
scenes.spades-6: Theme: exile, the outcast wandering the desolate fringes forever. A cloaked wanderer with a staff walking away along a barren grey shore; the lights of a walled city far behind; a single bundle on their back; a lone gull overhead; footprints filling with seawater; a signpost with every arm broken off; a dim lantern swinging from the staff.
scenes.spades-7: Theme: madness, the whispering voice in the dark that belongs to you alone. A person sits alone on the edge of a bed in a candlelit room at night, hands pressed over their ears; in the tall mirror beside them their reflection has turned to face them and leans close to whisper; the wallpaper's pattern faintly curls into the shapes of listening ears and half-open lips; a single candle burns with two flames; a chalk labyrinth drawn on the floor around the bed; a few playing cards scattered on the boards.
scenes.spades-8: Theme: echo, a solitary voice that only ever returns to itself. A vast empty hall of tall stone arches lined with facing mirrors; a single lit candle standing on the floor, its flame reflected again and again into infinity down the corridor of mirrors; a stopped pendulum clock; a white narcissus flower bending over a perfectly still pool with concentric ripples; a spiral staircase that leads nowhere; an open book whose pages repeat the same small picture.
scenes.spades-9: Theme: feral, the cornered beast abandoned by its pack. A lone gaunt wolf on a rocky outcrop at night, hackles raised and eyes watchful; the distant pack running away across a moonlit plain without it; a broken collar and chain in the grass; thorny brambles; a full moon half hidden by cloud; a deserted farmhouse with dark windows.
scenes.spades-10: Theme: purgatory, the endless wait in an empty room where the clocks have stopped. An empty waiting room with peeling wallpaper and rows of chairs; dozens of clocks on the wall, all stopped at different hours; a single figure seated with a numbered ticket in hand; a door with no handle; dust drifting in grey light; a withered plant; an hourglass with its sand frozen mid-fall; a staircase rising into fog.
scenes.spades-J: Theme: orphan, roots severed, a sapling withering in barren soil. The Page: a young boy in a coat too large for him stands alone on cracked, barren earth, holding a small sapling with torn roots; a family tree carved into a dead trunk behind him; an empty bird's nest at his feet; an open locket with no portrait; a faded rag doll; distant figures walking away into fog.
scenes.spades-Q: Theme: desert, the vast nothingness that parches the soul. The Queen: a veiled queen standing alone in an endless expanse of dunes under a white sun, wearing a crown of sun-bleached antlers; a cracked water jar at her feet; a shimmering mirage of an oasis on the horizon; a scorpion; a single cactus flower; an hourglass half buried in the sand; a vulture circling high above.
scenes.spades-K: Theme: silence, the unanswered prayer echoing into a hollow universe. The King of Silence: an old crowned king in heavy robes kneels alone at the centre of an immense empty cathedral, hands raised toward a great rose window that shows only a black, starless sky; a great bell hangs above him with no clapper; an extinguished censer trails a last thread of smoke; dust drifts through a single shaft of pale light.
scenes.hearts-A: Theme: scar, the record of pain etched into the skin as a warning. A woman seated on a stool in a candlelit room, seen from behind, a shawl lowered to bare her shoulders, which carry a long healed scar shaped like a branching constellation; she looks over her shoulder into a hand mirror to see it; on the table beside her a needle with red thread, a single thorned rose and a candle; a star chart pinned to the wall echoes the shape of the scar.
scenes.hearts-2: Theme: covenant, the pact sealed in secret between two desperate souls. Two cloaked figures clasping hands over a stone altar, a thin red cord binding their wrists together; a shared chalice; a ceremonial dagger laid across a closed book; two candles whose flames lean together into one; a pair of interlocked rings; a single red rose; a crescent moon and a dark sun above.
scenes.hearts-3: Theme: prophecy, the burden of knowing how the tragic end will unfold. A blindfolded seer seated on a bronze tripod above a cleft in the earth from which smoke rises, holding an open scroll that shows a falling tower; an eye inscribed on her brow; an owl on her shoulder; laurel leaves; a cracked mirror reflecting a distant sinking ship; a great wheel of fortune turning behind her.
scenes.hearts-4: Theme: altar, the hearth turned into a place of sacrifice to the unseen. A humble farmhouse kitchen at night where the hearth has become an altar: a white cloth over the mantel, candles burning, and offerings laid upon it, a loaf of bread, a cup of wine, a child's small shoe and a wedding ring; a woman kneels before the fire with bowed head; the smoke rises and gathers into the faint shape of a watching presence above the mantel; a family portrait draped in black ribbon hangs on the wall.
scenes.hearts-5: Theme: alchemy, transmuting suffering into spiritual gold. An alchemist in a candlelit laboratory pouring a dark liquid from one flask into another, where it turns to gold; an athanor furnace glowing; a crowned serpent coiled around a vessel; sun and moon emblems; a green lion devouring the sun; a raven and a peacock; a philosopher's egg on a stand.
scenes.hearts-6: Theme: cult, a society bound together by forbidden rites. A circle of hooded, robed figures holding candles in a moonlit forest clearing around a standing stone, all facing a leader in an antlered mask; a sigil circle drawn on the ground; incense smoke; one empty place left open in the circle, as if waiting for the viewer.
scenes.hearts-7: Theme: revelation, the sudden truth that shatters the mind's architecture. A figure tearing aside a great veil to reveal a blinding sunburst; shards of a shattered stained-glass window falling around them; a toppled statue; an open book with its pages blown wide; lightning striking a distant tower; an eye within a triangle; masks scattered on the floor.
scenes.hearts-8: Theme: fate, the unseen strings orchestrating every tragedy. The three Fates in a dim vaulted chamber: one seated at a spinning wheel spinning red thread, one standing and measuring it along her arm, one holding open shears; the red threads run down from their hands to a tiny town far below, where the little people move like marionettes on the strings; a great wheel of fortune turns in the shadows behind them; a spider spins its web in the corner.
scenes.hearts-9: Theme: familiar, the bound spirit whispering guidance from dark corners. A black cat with luminous eyes sitting on an open grimoire, leaning to whisper to a candlelit figure in shadow; a toad, a raven and a hare peering from the dark corners; dried herbs hanging from the beams; a crescent moon in the window; a key on a red ribbon.
scenes.hearts-10: Theme: karma, the compounding debt collected across lifetimes. A great pair of scales held by a winged figure, one pan heavy with coins and stones, the other holding a single feather; beneath it a wheel showing a child, an adult, an elder and a skeleton in an endless cycle; an ouroboros; an open ledger; ten lit candles; a moth drawn to one flame.
scenes.hearts-J: Theme: trauma, the early wound that scripts the tragedies to come. The Page: a small boy sits on the floor of a shadowy attic, clutching a cracked porcelain doll; a long crack runs from beneath him up the wall and across the ceiling like a fault line, branching outward through everything in the room; through a door left ajar come warm light and the tall shadows of quarrelling adults; marionettes hang limp from the rafters; an open music box sits beside him.
scenes.hearts-Q: Theme: venom, the earthly cure that takes from the weak to heal the strong. The Queen: a regal queen enthroned in a garden of poisonous flowers, holding a serpent coiled around a golden cup; foxglove, belladonna, nightshade and poppies around her throne; a vial of green tincture; a mortar and pestle; an apothecary's scale; a frail bird on one side and a strong stag on the other.
scenes.hearts-K: Theme: judgment, the final reckoning where the weight of a soul is measured. The King: a stern king on a throne of judgment holding great golden scales, a human heart on one pan and a single white feather on the other; an ibis-headed scribe recording the verdict; angels sounding trumpets in the clouds; an open book of deeds; a sword resting across his knees.
scenes.diamonds-A: Theme: spirit, the untethered form severed from the mortal coil. A luminous translucent figure rising out of a sleeping body lying in a meadow, the silver cord between them fraying and parting; an open birdcage with a white dove flying out; dandelion seeds on the wind; a ladder rising into the clouds; a butterfly; a crescent moon and a single bright star.
scenes.diamonds-2: Theme: betrayal, the severing of the last string that binds you to another heart. Two figures standing back to back, the cord that bound their wrists cut cleanly by a dagger in one figure's hand; a broken wax seal on a letter; thirty silver coins scattered on the ground; a rooster crowing; a cracked heart-shaped locket; a serpent in an apple tree.
scenes.diamonds-3: Theme: anarchy, the chaos when the final crown hits the floor. Inside a great throne hall, at the very moment a golden crown falls from an empty, toppling throne and strikes the stone floor, bouncing toward the viewer; behind it a jubilant crowd floods in through broken doors waving torches; a grinning jester has leapt onto the throne's seat; broken chains lie across the steps; torn banners fall from the rafters; a flock of birds bursts out through the tall windows.
scenes.diamonds-4: Theme: vagabond, the restless wanderer who has burned every bridge. A ragged traveller with a bundle on a stick walks away down a moonlit country road, a stray dog trotting at his heels; behind him, across a river, a wooden bridge burns brightly; at a crossroads a signpost points in every direction; a roofless, abandoned cottage stands by the roadside; his pockets are turned out and empty; a single feather in his hat.
scenes.diamonds-5: Theme: ruin, the collapse of ambition into liberating nothingness. A figure sitting serenely cross-legged among the fallen stones of a collapsed tower; a broken crown and scattered coins around them; a ladder snapped in half; a scroll of plans burning; a single flower growing from a crack; an open sky full of stars above; birds flying free.
scenes.diamonds-6: Theme: heresy, the forbidden sin that liberates the shackled mind. A young woman in a plain grey robe walks out through the great doors of a dark cathedral into the open night, broken shackles falling from her wrists, a lantern held high in one hand and an apple with a single bite in the other; torn pages of scripture swirl away on the wind behind her; a serpent coils calmly around the doorpost; a bright star shines overhead; inside, the shadow of a pyre falls across the cathedral wall.
scenes.diamonds-7: Theme: confession, sins drawn out to cleanse a rotting core. A figure kneels at the latticed screen of a wooden confessional booth, head bowed, hands cupped before them; dark ink pours from their cupped hands into a silver basin on the floor, where it runs clear as water; through the lattice only a candle and the silhouette of a listener; a broken chain lies at their knees; a key turns in the booth's lock; a white lily stands in a vase.
scenes.diamonds-8: Theme: chaos, the universal mirror shattered into jagged shards. A great ornate mirror shattering in mid-air, each jagged shard reflecting a different landscape; dice tumbling; playing cards scattering; a broken compass; a storm wind swirling into a vortex at the centre; a laughing jester; birds wheeling through the fragments.
scenes.diamonds-9: Theme: predator, the instinct to hunt without remorse. A panther crouched in tall moonlit grass, eyes glowing, about to spring; a hunting horn and an arrow lying in the grass; a startled hare far off in the distance; drifting feathers; claw marks raked into a tree trunk; a crescent moon.
scenes.diamonds-10: Theme: oblivion, the sweet erasure of memory and tomorrow. A figure drifting in a small boat across a dark, still river, cupping water to drink; memories sinking beneath the surface: letters, portraits, keys and a child's toy; poppies along the banks; a lantern with a dimming flame; a hooded ferryman; a white water lily; a starless night sky.
scenes.diamonds-J: Theme: runaway, blind flight into the black woods, never to return. The Page: a barefoot child running away into a dense, dark forest with a small bundle on a stick and a swinging lantern; the warm lit window of home far behind; a broken gate; a trail of breadcrumbs being eaten by birds; owls watching from the branches; a red ribbon caught on a thorn bush.
scenes.diamonds-Q: Theme: wildfire, the blaze that purges the overgrown forest. The Queen: a fierce queen with hair of flame striding through a burning forest, holding a torch, her robes made of embers; animals fleeing ahead of her; green shoots already rising from the ashes behind her; a phoenix ascending; pine cones bursting open in the heat; a salamander; a red sun.
scenes.diamonds-K: Theme: deicide, the death of the old gods that leaves mortals alone in the dark. The King: a mortal king standing over the shattered colossal statue of an old god lying broken on a temple floor, the god's crown in one hand and a lit lantern in the other; the heavens above cracked open and empty; extinguished altar fires; scattered offerings; worshippers gazing upward in fear.

_notes.spades-8: Earlier versions with a figure calling out and the nymph Echo (or a weeping statue) were blocked by the generator's content filter; this figure-free scene passed. Its prompt omitted the 'not horror' sentence of style.after.
_notes.regenerated-2026-11-14: Critical review: 18 cards regenerated for clutter, floating emblems/lettering, unclear focal points or symbols that did not read.
_notes.spades-2: The handprint-on-glass version came out with a six-fingered hand (and an image edit could not fix it); the handprint and glove were dropped.

back.prompt: Ornate playing card back design, a single full-bleed design that fills the entire canvas edge to edge, perfectly symmetrical left to right and top to bottom like a real playing card back. No text, no letters, no numbers. Fine antique line engraving in luminous metallic gold on a deep matte black background, like gold foil stamped onto black card stock. Esoteric tarot symbolism in the tradition of the Rider-Waite and Thoth decks and old alchemical emblem books: at the centre a radiant sun with an all-seeing eye, encircled by an ouroboros serpent and a ring of thirteen moon phases; four corner medallions holding a club, a spade, a heart and a diamond; garlands of laurel and poppies, crossed keys, small hourglasses, stars and fine sunrays; a double border of delicate filigree scrollwork. Intricate, balanced, elegant and mysterious, museum-quality engraving.
back.output: public/cards/back.webp (the second of two results; resized to 1200px wide)
